intent: Export the regular action of Z_12_v1 on the 12-slot index set I_12_v1, providing a typed group-action primitive for later strict constructions that want to talk about a 12-cycle without hidden conventions.
hard_limits: Does not define a canonical embedding of Z_12 into U(1).
Does not provide a strict O(2)-cut selector ingredient (QW-2191 remains open).
Does not derive eps/delta_d and does not eliminate selector slots.
Does not export theta_1/theta_2 and does not claim ToE closure.
